cases.scenario: Logged-in patient books an open slot
cases.pre: Alice is registered and logged in; Dr Grace Chen has an open slot on Mon 19 Oct 11:00.
steps: Open Find a doctor and select Dr Grace Chen
Select Mon 19 Oct and the 11:00am slot
Enter a reason and click Confirm booking
cases.data: alice@demo.com / Patient@123; Doctor d7; 2026-10-19 11:00; Reason "Persistent cough"
cases.expected: Confirmation page "Appointment confirmed" with reference APT-1013; the appointment is listed under Upcoming with status Booked.

cases.scenario: Guest selects a slot, is asked to log in, and returns to complete the booking
cases.pre: User is not logged in.
steps: Open Dr Grace Chen profile as a guest
Select Mon 19 Oct 11:00 and click Continue to book
cases.expected: Guest is redirected to Log in with a message; after login the Review and confirm page opens for the same slot; booking is confirmed.

cases.scenario: New patient registers and books their first appointment
cases.pre: Email test.patient@demo.com is not registered.
steps: Open Register and complete all fields
Book Dr Amelia Okafor, Tue 20 Oct 14:00
cases.expected: Account created and patient dashboard opens with 0 upcoming; booking is confirmed and shown in Upcoming.

cases.scenario: An already-booked slot is shown as unavailable and cannot be selected
cases.pre: Ben has Dr Priya Raman on Fri 16 Oct 10:30.
steps: Open Dr Priya Raman, select Fri 16 Oct
cases.expected: 10:30am is struck through and disabled; clicking it does not select it; Continue to book stays disabled.

cases.scenario: Booking an occupied slot by opening the booking URL directly is rejected
cases.pre: Alice logged in; d1 Fri 16 Oct 10:30 booked by Ben.
cases.expected: Error "This slot is no longer available. Choose another time." [BR-02]; Confirm booking disabled.

cases.scenario: Slot is taken by another patient while the first patient is on the review page
cases.pre: Alice on Review and confirm for d7 Mon 19 Oct 11:30.
steps: Select d7 Mon 19 Oct 11:30 and continue
Open Demo tools and click "Another patient books this slot"
cases.expected: Booking is blocked with "This slot is no longer available" and a link to choose another time; no appointment is created for Alice.

cases.scenario: Patient cannot book two appointments at the same date and time with different doctors
cases.pre: Alice has APT-1001 with Dr Raman on Fri 16 Oct 10:00.
cases.expected: Error "You already have an appointment at this time (APT-1001)." [BR-11]; Confirm disabled.

cases.scenario: Once a slot is booked, a second patient cannot book the same doctor and time
cases.pre: Dr Omar Haddad Mon 19 Oct 14:00 is open.
steps: Log out; register a second patient
Open d6 profile on Mon 19 Oct
cases.expected: Second patient sees 2:00pm as booked; direct booking shows BR-02 error; the doctor has only one appointment at that time.

cases.scenario: Booking a date/time in the past is rejected
cases.pre: Alice logged in. Current time Wed 14 Oct 08:00.
steps: Open the profile: past dates are not shown and today's past slots are disabled
cases.expected: Date strip starts today; error "This date and time is in the past. Choose a future slot." [BR-09]; Confirm disabled.

cases.scenario: Time not on a 30-minute boundary or outside 09:00–16:30 is rejected
cases.pre: Alice logged in.
cases.expected: Both show "Appointments start on the half hour between 9:00am and 4:30pm." [BR-09].

cases.scenario: Time outside the doctor's published availability, and non-clinic days
cases.pre: Dr James Whitfield works mornings only. No clinics at weekends.
steps: Open Dr Priya Raman, select Sat 17 Oct
cases.expected: Saturday shows "Closed" and "No clinic on this day"; direct booking shows "The doctor is not available at this time." [BR-04].

cases.scenario: Malformed date/time and dates beyond the 30-day booking horizon are rejected
cases.pre: Alice logged in.
cases.expected: First two: "Select a valid date and time." [BR-04]. Third: "Appointments can be booked up to 30 days ahead." [BR-09].

cases.scenario: Patient cancels an upcoming appointment more than 2 hours ahead
cases.pre: Alice has APT-1001 (Fri 16 Oct 10:00).
steps: Click Cancel appointment in the dialog
cases.expected: Dialog asks for confirmation; toast confirms the slot is free; APT-1001 leaves Upcoming and appears under Past & cancelled as Cancelled.

cases.scenario: A cancelled appointment releases the slot for other patients
cases.pre: Alice has cancelled APT-1001 (d1 Fri 16 Oct 10:00).
steps: Log out and register a new patient
Open Dr Priya Raman, Fri 16 Oct
cases.expected: 10:00am shows as available again and the new patient can book it.

cases.scenario: Patient cannot cancel online less than 2 hours before the appointment
cases.pre: Clock 10:00 on Wed 14 Oct. Chloe has APT-1011 today at 11:30.
steps: Open My appointments and find APT-1011
cases.expected: Cancel and Reschedule are disabled; message says changes are not possible online within 2 hours and gives the hospital phone number.

cases.scenario: Doctor cancels an appointment with a reason; patient sees it cancelled
cases.pre: Dr Raman logged in; APT-1001 on Fri 16 Oct 10:00.
steps: Schedule tab, go to Fri 16 Oct
Click Cancel appointment with an empty reason
Log in as Alice and check Past & cancelled
cases.expected: Empty reason is rejected ("Enter a reason for cancelling."); with a reason the status becomes Cancelled; Alice sees APT-1001 as Cancelled.

cases.scenario: Patient reschedules to another open slot with the same doctor
cases.pre: Alice has APT-1001 (d1 Fri 16 Oct 10:00).
steps: Check Dr Raman Fri 16 Oct 10:00 as another patient
cases.expected: Confirmation shows Fri 16 Oct 11:00am with the same reference APT-1001; the old 10:00 slot is available again.

cases.scenario: Patient cannot reschedule into an unavailable slot
cases.pre: Alice rescheduling APT-1001; Ben holds 10:30 the same day.
cases.expected: Both slots disabled (10:00 labelled "current"); Confirm new time stays disabled; appointment unchanged.

cases.scenario: Rescheduling is blocked less than 2 hours before the appointment
cases.pre: Clock 10:00 Wed 14 Oct; Chloe's APT-1011 is today 11:30.
cases.expected: Error with BR-10; no slot picker shown.

cases.scenario: Admin reschedules an appointment on behalf of a patient
cases.pre: Admin logged in; Ben has APT-1007 with Dr Nowak Mon 19 Oct 11:00.
cases.expected: Returns to the admin appointment list; APT-1007 shows Mon 19 Oct, 11:30am.

cases.scenario: Each role lands on its own dashboard after login
cases.pre: Demo accounts exist for each role.
steps: Log out, log in as doctor
Log out, log in as admin
cases.expected: Patient → My appointments; Doctor → Schedule; Admin → Hospital administration.

cases.scenario: Invalid or missing credentials are rejected with a generic message
cases.pre: On the Log in page.
steps: Submit alice@demo.com with a wrong password
cases.expected: Empty: "Enter your email and password." Wrong password and unknown email both show the same "Invalid email or password." User stays on Log in.

cases.scenario: Guest cannot open protected pages
cases.pre: Not logged in.
cases.expected: Each redirects to Log in (with return path).

cases.scenario: Users cannot open another role's pages; doctors see only their own appointments
cases.pre: Alice and Dr Raman accounts.
steps: As Dr Raman view Mon 19 Oct schedule
cases.data: APT-1007 belongs to Dr Nowak on Mon 19 Oct
cases.expected: Alice is returned to My appointments with "You do not have access to that page."; doctor returned to Schedule; Dr Raman's schedule never shows APT-1007.

cases.scenario: Deactivated patient cannot log in
cases.pre: Daniel Price's account is deactivated.
cases.expected: "This account is deactivated. Contact the hospital." and the user stays on Log in.

cases.scenario: Admin cancels a patient's appointment with a reason
cases.pre: Admin logged in; APT-1002 (Alice, Dr Chen, Wed 21 Oct) is Booked.
steps: Enter reason "Patient called to cancel" and confirm
cases.expected: Status changes to Cancelled; slot released; action appears in Recent activity.

cases.scenario: Doctor publishes a new slot and patients can see it
cases.pre: Dr Raman has no 12:30 slot on Tue 20 Oct.
steps: Doctor > Availability, go to Tue 20 Oct
Log out; open Dr Raman profile as guest on Tue 20 Oct
cases.expected: Slot changes to Open; guest sees 12:30pm as an available slot.

cases.scenario: Doctor removes an open slot and it disappears for patients
cases.pre: Dr Raman has an open 09:00 slot on Tue 20 Oct.
steps: Check the profile as a guest
cases.expected: Slot shows Not available; 9:00am no longer listed on the profile.

cases.scenario: Doctor cannot remove a slot that is already booked
cases.pre: APT-1001 (Alice) occupies Fri 16 Oct 10:00.
cases.expected: Error "This slot is booked (APT-1001). Cancel the appointment first." [BR-12]; slot stays Booked.

cases.scenario: Doctor cannot add availability for a past date or beyond 30 days
cases.pre: Dr Raman logged in.
steps: Go to Sat 14 Nov (31 days ahead)
cases.expected: Past date: warning and "Publish whole day" disabled; adding a slot is rejected. Beyond 30 days: warning and Publish disabled.

cases.scenario: Doctor can mark an appointment completed only after its start time
cases.pre: APT-1006 (Ben) was yesterday 09:00 and is still Booked; APT-1001 is Fri 16 Oct.
steps: Schedule > Tue 13 Oct, click Mark completed on APT-1006
Go to Fri 16 Oct and check APT-1001
cases.expected: APT-1006 becomes Completed; "Mark completed" is disabled for future APT-1001.

cases.scenario: Doctor publishes a whole day further ahead and patients see the new slots
cases.pre: Mon 2 Nov has no availability for Dr Raman.
steps: Open Dr Raman profile as a patient, scroll the date strip to 2 Nov
cases.expected: All 16 slots (9:00–16:30) become Open; patient date strip shows "16 free" for 2 Nov.

cases.scenario: Admin deactivates a doctor; doctor disappears from search
cases.pre: Dr Grace Chen is active with upcoming bookings.
steps: Admin > Doctors, click Deactivate for Dr Grace Chen
As guest open Find a doctor and #/doctors/d7
cases.expected: Warning shows the number of upcoming appointments; status Inactive; Dr Chen not listed; profile shows "Doctor not available".

cases.scenario: Admin adds a doctor (with validation)
cases.pre: Admin logged in.
steps: Click Add doctor with empty form
As guest filter Find a doctor by ENT
cases.data: Dr Test Doctor; test.doctor@hospital.demo; ENT; £75; 5 yrs; MBBS
cases.expected: Empty form shows field errors; after saving the doctor appears in the table and in ENT search with "No free slots in the next 30 days".

cases.scenario: Admin filters appointments and exports a report
cases.pre: Admin logged in; seed data loaded.
cases.expected: Only cancelled appointments listed (APT-1004); report shows totals by status and doctor; CSV downloads with one row per appointment; invalid range shows an error.

cases.scenario: Registration rejects a duplicate email and invalid fields
cases.pre: alice@demo.com already registered.
steps: Open Register, click Create account with empty form
Enter alice@demo.com, valid other fields, mismatched confirm password
cases.expected: Empty form: errors on all 5 required fields. Mismatch: "Passwords do not match." Duplicate: "An account with this email already exists." No account created.

cases.scenario: Patient with 3 upcoming appointments cannot book a fourth
cases.pre: Ben has 3 upcoming appointments.
steps: Select Dr Grace Chen Mon 19 Oct 10:00 and continue
cases.expected: "You can hold up to 3 upcoming appointments. Cancel one to book another." [BR-16]; Confirm disabled.

cases.scenario: Booking journey works on a mobile screen (390 × 844)
cases.pre: Mobile viewport.
steps: Open the site on a 390px wide screen
Log in as Alice and book Dr Grace Chen Mon 19 Oct 10:00
cases.expected: Navigation collapses behind a Menu button; no horizontal scrolling; booking completes.

10:30am shown as booked (struck through, disabled); click had no effect; Continue to book remained disabled.
Error shown: "This slot is no longer available. Choose another time. Choose another time BR-02"; Confirm booking disabled.
Error shown: "This slot is no longer available. Choose another time. Choose another time BR-02"; Confirm disabled; Alice still has 2 upcoming appointments (none created).
Blocked: "You already have an appointment at this time (APT-1001). BR-11".

Dialog "Cancel this appointment?"; toast "Appointment APT-1001 cancelled. The slot is now free for other patients."; APT-1001 now under Past & cancelled as Cancelled.

Cancel and Reschedule disabled; message "Appointments can't be changed online less than 2 hours before the start. Call the hospital on 020 7946 0000.".

APT-1007 now "APT-1007 Mon, 19 Oct, 11:30am Ben Carter Dr Tomasz Nowak Booked RescheduleCancel".
alice@demo.com → /patient ("My appointments"); priya.raman@hospital.demo → /doctor ("Dr Priya Raman"); admin@hospital.demo → /admin ("Hospital administration")

All redirected to login: /login?redirect=/patient | /login?redirect=/admin | /login?redirect=/book/d7?date=2026-10-19&time=10:00

16 slots published; patient view shows "16 free" on Mon 2 Nov.

5 field errors on empty form; doctor added; ENT search shows Dr Test Doctor with "No free slots in the next 30 days".
